name: Caught!
summary: In Searing Gorge, someone is calling for help from a locked outhouse. The voice inside asks you to teach eight Dark Iron geologists a lesson and bring fifteen pieces of silk cloth, though they offer no reason.

sections.title: Locked In
sections.body: The occupant fled the Dark Iron dwarves and hid in the outhouse. They believe the geologists saw them slip inside and used their magic to lock the door before they could get away.

sections.title: Two Favors
sections.body: The trapped person asks you to teach eight Dark Iron geologists a lesson and bring fifteen pieces of silk cloth. When you ask why, they stumble over their words, then say it is for nothing in particular.

faq.q: Who is trapped inside the outhouse?
aliases: who is locked in the outhouse
faq.answer: An unnamed person who fled the Dark Iron dwarves is trapped inside after hiding in the outhouse.

faq.q: Why does the occupant want silk cloth?
aliases: why does outhouse guy want silk
faq.answer: The occupant asks for fifteen pieces of silk cloth, then stumbles over the reason and says it is for nothing in particular.
The occupant believes the Dark Iron geologists saw them hide and used their magic to lock the outhouse door.

faq.q: How many geologists must be slain?
faq.answer: The occupant asks you to deal with eight Dark Iron geologists.
